q: “Hello! How are you?” Which answer is good?
fr: « Hello! How are you? » Quelle réponse convient ?
es: « Hello! How are you? » ¿Qué respuesta es adecuada?

why.en: “How are you?” asks how you feel. You can answer “I’m fine, thank you.”
why.fr: « How are you? » demande comment tu vas. On répond « I’m fine, thank you. » (Je vais bien, merci.)
why.es: « How are you? » pregunta cómo estás. Se responde « I’m fine, thank you. » (Estoy bien, gracias.)

qa: Hello! How are you? Which answer is good?

q: What do you say in the morning?
fr: Que dit-on le matin ?

why.en: “Good morning” is how you greet people in the morning.

qa: What do you say in the morning?

q: What do you say before you go to bed?
fr: Que dit-on avant d'aller dormir ?
es: ¿Qué se dice antes de ir a dormir?

why.en: “Good night” is for the end of the day, before sleeping.

qa: What do you say before you go to bed?

q: Someone says “Thank you!”. What do you answer?
fr: Quelqu’un te dit « Thank you! ». Que réponds-tu ?
es: Alguien te dice « Thank you! ». ¿Qué respondes?

why.en: “You’re welcome” is the polite answer to “Thank you”.

qa: Someone says Thank you!. What do you answer?

q: You step on someone's foot. What do you say?
fr: Tu marches sur le pied de quelqu'un. Que dis-tu ?
es: Pisas el pie de alguien. ¿Qué dices?

why.en: “Sorry” is what you say when you make a mistake or hurt someone.

qa: You step on someone's foot. What do you say?

q: You are leaving. What do you say?
fr: Tu t’en vas. Que dis-tu ?

why.en: “Goodbye” is what you say when you leave.

qa: You are leaving. What do you say?

q: “What’s your name?” Which answer is good?
fr: « What’s your name? » Quelle réponse convient ?
es: « What’s your name? » ¿Qué respuesta es adecuada?

why.en: “What’s your name?” asks for your name: “My name is…”.
why.fr: « What’s your name? » = comment tu t’appelles ? On répond « My name is Anna. »
why.es: « What’s your name? » = ¿cómo te llamas? Se responde « My name is Anna. »

qa: What's your name? Which answer is good?

q: “How old are you?” Which answer is good?
fr: « How old are you? » Quelle réponse convient ?
es: « How old are you? » ¿Qué respuesta es adecuada?

why.en: “How old are you?” asks your age: “I’m twenty.”
why.fr: « How old are you? » = quel âge as-tu ? On répond « I’m twenty. »
why.es: « How old are you? » = ¿cuántos años tienes? Se responde « I’m twenty. »

qa: How old are you? Which answer is good?

q: “Where are you from?” Which answer is good?
fr: « Where are you from? » Quelle réponse convient ?
es: « Where are you from? » ¿Qué respuesta es adecuada?

why.en: “Where are you from?” asks for your country or town: “I’m from…”.
why.fr: « Where are you from? » = d’où viens-tu ? On répond « I’m from France. »
why.es: « Where are you from? » = ¿de dónde eres? Se responde « I’m from France. »

qa: Where are you from? Which answer is good?

q: Someone says “Nice to meet you.” What do you answer?
fr: Quelqu’un te dit « Nice to meet you. ». Que réponds-tu ?
es: Alguien te dice « Nice to meet you. ». ¿Qué respondes?

why.en: You answer “Nice to meet you, too.” (too = also).
why.fr: « Nice to meet you, too. » = enchanté(e) aussi.
why.es: « Nice to meet you, too. » = encantado/a yo también.

qa: Someone says Nice to meet you. What do you answer?

q: I ___ a student.
fr: Complète : « I ___ a student. »

why.en: With “I” we use “am”: I am.
why.fr: Avec « I » (je), on utilise « am » : I am (je suis).
why.es: Con « I » (yo) se usa « am »: I am (yo soy).

qa: Complete the sentence. I blank a student.

q: She ___ happy.
fr: Complète : « She ___ happy. »

why.en: With he, she, it we use “is”.
why.fr: Avec he, she, it (il, elle), on utilise « is ».
why.es: Con he, she, it (él, ella) se usa « is ».

qa: Complete the sentence. She blank happy.

q: They ___ at home.
fr: Complète : « They ___ at home. »

why.en: With you, we, they we use “are”.
why.fr: Avec you, we, they (vous, nous, ils), on utilise « are ».
why.es: Con you, we, they (vosotros, nosotros, ellos) se usa « are ».

qa: Complete the sentence. They blank at home.

q: He ___ a new bike.
fr: Complète : « He ___ a new bike. »

why.en: “To have” becomes “has” with he, she, it.
why.fr: « To have » (avoir) devient « has » avec he, she, it.
why.es: « To have » (tener) se convierte en « has » con he, she, it.

qa: Complete the sentence. He blank a new bike.

q: I ___ two brothers.
fr: Complète : « I ___ two brothers. »

why.en: With I, you, we, they we say “have”.
why.fr: Avec I, you, we, they, on dit « have » (j’ai).
why.es: Con I, you, we, they se dice « have » (tengo).

qa: Complete the sentence. I blank two brothers.

q: This is ___ apple.
fr: Complète : « This is ___ apple. »

why.en: We use “an” before a vowel sound: an apple, an egg.
why.fr: On utilise « an » devant une voyelle : an apple, an egg.
why.es: Se usa « an » delante de una vocal: an apple, an egg.

qa: Complete the sentence. This is blank apple.

q: I have ___ dog.
fr: Complète : « I have ___ dog. »

why.en: We use “a” before a consonant sound: a dog, a book.
why.fr: On utilise « a » devant une consonne : a dog, a book.
why.es: Se usa « a » delante de una consonante: a dog, a book.

qa: Complete the sentence. I have blank dog.

q: One cat, two ___.
fr: Complète : « One cat, two ___. »

why.en: Most plurals just add -s: cat → cats.
why.fr: La plupart des pluriels ajoutent -s : cat → cats.
why.es: La mayoría de plurales añaden -s: cat → cats.

qa: Complete the sentence. One cat, two blank .

q: One child, two ___.
fr: Complète : « One child, two ___. »

why.en: “Child” has an irregular plural: children.
why.fr: « Child » a un pluriel irrégulier : children.
why.es: « Child » tiene un plural irregular: children.

qa: Complete the sentence. One child, two blank .

q: ___ is your name?
fr: Complète : « ___ is your name? »

why.en: “What” asks about a thing: What is your name?
why.fr: « What » (quoi, quel) : What is your name?
why.es: « What » (qué, cuál): What is your name?

qa: Complete the sentence. blank is your name?

q: The book is ___ the table.
fr: Complète : « The book is ___ the table. »
es: Completa: « The book is ___ the table. »

why.en: “On” means touching the top of something: on the table.
why.fr: « On » = sur : on the table (sur la table).
why.es: « On » = sobre, encima de: on the table (sobre la mesa).

qa: Complete the sentence. The book is blank the table.
aa: The book is on the table.

q: This is my sister. ___ name is Maria.
fr: Complète : « This is my sister. ___ name is Maria. »
es: Completa: « This is my sister. ___ name is Maria. »

why.en: “Her” is for a girl or a woman: her name.
why.fr: « Her » = son/sa (d’une fille ou d’une femme) : her name.
why.es: « Her » = su (de una chica o mujer): her name.

qa: Complete the sentence. This is my sister. blank name is Maria.
aa: This is my sister. Her name is Maria.

q: What is the English word for 3?

why.en: 3 = three. (A “tree” is an arbre / un árbol; 30 = thirty.)

why.en: 7 = seven. 17 = seventeen, 70 = seventy.

qa: What is the English word for this number?

why.en: 12 = twelve. 20 = twenty.

q: What day comes after Monday?
fr: Quel jour vient après Monday (lundi) ?

why.en: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday.
why.fr: Monday (lundi), Tuesday (mardi), Wednesday (mercredi), Thursday (jeudi), Friday (vendredi), Saturday (samedi), Sunday (dimanche).
why.es: Monday (lunes), Tuesday (martes), Wednesday (miércoles), Thursday (jueves), Friday (viernes), Saturday (sábado), Sunday (domingo).

qa: What day comes after Monday?

q: Which word is a month?
fr: Quel mot est un mois ?

why.en: March is a month (mars). Monday is a day, morning is a part of the day.
why.fr: « March » = mars. « Monday » est un jour, « morning » le matin.
why.es: « March » = marzo. « Monday » es un día, « morning » la mañana.

qa: Which word is a month?

q: It is 3:00. What do you say?
fr: Il est 3 h. Que dit-on ?

why.en: For a full hour we say “It’s … o’clock”.
why.fr: Pour une heure pile : « It’s three o’clock » (il est trois heures).
why.es: Para una hora en punto: « It’s three o’clock » (son las tres).

qa: It is three oh oh. What do you say?

q: Which days are the weekend?
fr: Quels jours forment le week-end ?
es: ¿Qué días forman el fin de semana?

why.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday.
why.fr: Le week-end, c’est Saturday (samedi) et Sunday (dimanche).
why.es: El fin de semana es Saturday (sábado) y Sunday (domingo).

qa: Which days are the weekend?

q: Which is the first month of the year?
fr: Quel est le premier mois de l’année ?
es: ¿Cuál es el primer mes del año?

why.en: January is the first month, December the last.
why.fr: January (janvier) est le premier mois, December (décembre) le dernier.
why.es: January (enero) es el primer mes, December (diciembre) el último.

qa: Which is the first month of the year?

q: Your mother and your father are your ___.
fr: Ta mère et ton père sont tes ___.
es: Tu madre y tu padre son tus ___.

why.en: Mother + father = parents.

qa: Complete the sentence. Your mother and your father are your blank .
aa: Your mother and your father are your parents.

q: Your mother's mother is your ___.
fr: La mère de ta mère est ta ___.
es: La madre de tu madre es tu ___.

why.en: The mother of your mother or father is your grandmother.

qa: Complete the sentence. Your mother's mother is your blank .
aa: Your mother's mother is your grandmother.

q: I ___ breakfast at eight o’clock.
fr: Complète : « I ___ breakfast at eight o’clock. »
es: Completa: « I ___ breakfast at eight o’clock. »

why.en: In English we “have” breakfast, lunch and dinner.
why.fr: En anglais, on « have » breakfast (prend le petit-déjeuner).
why.es: En inglés se dice « have breakfast » (desayunar).

qa: Complete the sentence. I blank breakfast at eight o'clock.
aa: I have breakfast at eight o'clock.

q: You write with a ___.
fr: On écrit avec un ___.

why.en: You write with a pen (or a pencil).

qa: Complete the sentence. You write with a blank .

q: What is the opposite of “big”?
fr: Quel est le contraire de « big » ?

why.en: big ↔ small.

qa: What is the opposite of big?

q: What is the opposite of “hot”?
fr: Quel est le contraire de « hot » ?

why.en: hot ↔ cold.

qa: What is the opposite of hot?

q: What colour is the sky on a sunny day?
fr: De quelle couleur est le ciel un jour de soleil ?
es: ¿De qué color es el cielo en un día de sol?

why.en: The sky is blue.

qa: What colour is the sky on a sunny day?

q: Complete: “I ___ English.”
fr: Complète : « I ___ English. »

why.en: With “I” the verb has no ending: I speak. Well done!
why.fr: Avec « I », le verbe ne change pas : I speak (je parle). Bravo !
why.es: Con « I », el verbo no cambia: I speak (hablo). ¡Muy bien!

qa: Complete the sentence. I blank English.
